title: Disable Riptide During Elytra Flight
description: This project disables the use of the riptide enchantment when flying with the elytra.
body:
This project disables the use of the riptide enchantment when flying with the elytra. The datapack does this by temporarly removing the riptide enchantment when the elytra is deployed. It then gives the enchantment back when you land.

This datapack are for those who think the riptide + elytra combo is too OP.

Code was written with the help of Gemini. I do not take responsibility for any damages this code may cause to any save file or machine. Anyone may modify and/or redistribute this datapack without restrictions. Use at your own discretion.
